proof_attempt_summary: The original all-law efficient-information program did not close its reverse tangent inclusion, certified exact-bound computation, or full attainment classification. Discovery narrowed to moment-relaxation inference and a certified mixture-law upper gain, but the referee assessed incremental novelty below the field floor and no bounded in-scope upgrade. The math panel still required one dependency repair and two cited-source coverage repairs; these were not re-reviewed, so this archive is failed and does not assert that the narrowed package is sound.
tldr: Treatment-noise changes identify a confounded causal slope in a restrictive stable-independent-source benchmark. A lawful observed slope score and explicit all-path moment controls give \(\|\ell_\beta\|_H^{-2}\le V_{\mathrm{eff}}\le V_{\mathrm{mom}}\le V_{\mathrm{quad}}\). One original-record estimator attains \(V_{\mathrm{mom}}/n\), is regular under every observed DQM path, and supplies asymptotically normal inference with consistent variance and valid Wald intervals at every interior law. It is fully efficient at jointly Gaussian laws. At the legal non-Gaussian witness its coefficient is below \(22.449\), versus \(29.6\) for every quadratic influence. Effective observed-density presentations permit honest finite offline certificates; moment upper certificates converge to \(V_{\mathrm{mom}}\), and full-bound tolerance stopping is proved in Gaussian equality cases. Exhaustive observed-score characterization, general full efficiency, primitive attainability and non-Gaussian saturation classification remain open.
gap: Specified-moment GMM and invertible square-ICA efficiency do not characterize every observed DQM direction of coupled overcomplete convolutions. General inverse-functional theory does not establish the destination operator or its primitive observable iff efficient-attainability criterion. Statistical identification of the bound does not itself furnish effective numerical access to an arbitrary smooth density.
fill: An unconditional exact information and efficient-attainability theorem is paired with conditional offline evaluation from certified observed-density integrals and a separate adaptive sample-only efficient-inference theorem. Finite brackets certify variance and squared influence error to any positive tolerance when the effective presentation is available. Attainability universality and quadratic saturation are exact observable classification targets, without a total finite equality or attainment test.
